title: tessera.calibration-spec/1
description: What `tessera-quant compile` draws its calibration set from (02 §2.1, RFC-0005 'Calibration'): a dataset source and the sizes of the draw, whose seed is `--seed`. Paths are relative to the file. `tessera_quant.cli` reads it strictly: no key may be missing or unknown.

tokens_per_sequence.description: Tokens per sequence, the beginning-of-text token included: 2,048 by RFC-0005. At most the model's context.

held_out.description: Sequences of the split on which the migration strength is chosen: 64 by RFC-0005.

source.description: A dataset: the string "c4", C4's `en` validation split at the revision RFC-0005 pins, fetched from the Hugging Face Hub; or JSON-lines files of `text` fields, gzip-compressed when a name ends in `.gz`, read in order, with the identity the reports record.
